name: Storm-Oath Rime Raider
loreTies: A shield-sworn raider who treats every Gate incursion as an oath trial; hostile run-ins are ritual challenge, not banditry.
Closes distance and uses chokepoints to force Deity repositioning.
source culture humans later copied as Norse myth
shortBackstory: Storm-Oath Rime Raider is a lore-faithful Asgardian run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Storm-Oath Rime Raider belongs to The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds and exists to express Asgardian law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Closes distance and uses chokepoints to force Deity repositioning.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Frost-iron mail, storm-root knots, raven-black cloak strips, bridge-rune shield marks that are symbolic rather than readable text. Abilities — Rime Axe Hook, Bridge-Oath Charge, Shieldwall Break — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
